SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW v1 AS VALUES (1, 1, 1), (2, 2, 1) AS t(a, b, k)
SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW v2 AS VALUES (1, 1, 1), (2, 2, 1) AS t(x, y, all)
READ	SELECT max(a) AS b, b FROM v1 GROUP BY k
READ	SELECT a FROM v1 WHERE (12, 13) IN (SELECT max(x + 10) AS a, a + 1 FROM v2)
READ	SELECT a AS k FROM v1 GROUP BY k
READ	SELECT x FROM v2 GROUP BY all
READ	SELECT a AS all, b FROM v1 GROUP BY all
READ	SELECT k AS lca, lca + 1 AS col FROM v1 GROUP BY k, col
READ	SELECT k AS lca, lca + 1 AS col FROM v1 GROUP BY all
READ	SELECT k AS lca, lca + 1 AS col FROM v1 GROUP BY lca
READ	SELECT * FROM v2 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT a, b FROM v1 GROUP BY all)
